POSSIBLE_ACS: Possible acute coronary syndrome - combination of symptoms suggests potential heart attack or unstable angina
ABNORMAL_TROPONIN: Abnormal troponin level detected - may indicate heart muscle injury
TROPONIN_CHEST_PAIN: Elevated troponin with chest pain symptoms
CARDIAC_ARREST: Signs consistent with cardiac arrest - immediate life-threatening emergency
STROKE_SIGNS: Signs consistent with stroke (FAST criteria) - time-critical emergency
SEVERE_RESPIRATORY_DISTRESS: Severe difficulty breathing - potential respiratory or cardiac emergency
ANAPHYLAXIS: Signs of severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) - life-threatening emergency
UNCONTROLLED_HEMORRHAGE: Severe uncontrolled bleeding - potential life-threatening blood loss
SYNCOPE_UNRESPONSIVE: Loss of consciousness or unresponsiveness - requires emergency evaluation
DIABETES_CARDIAC_RISK: Diabetes present - increases risk of cardiac events and warrants more urgent evaluation
ELDERLY_RISK: Age over 65 - increased risk for serious cardiac and vascular events
PRIOR_MI_RISK: History of prior heart attack - significantly increases risk of recurrent cardiac events
SOB_CHEST_PAIN: Shortness of breath with chest pain - concerning for cardiac or pulmonary emergency
SUDDEN_SOB: Sudden onset shortness of breath at rest - requires urgent evaluation
SOB_FEVER: Shortness of breath with fever - possible respiratory infection
MILD_SOB: Mild exertional shortness of breath - routine evaluation recommended
SURGICAL_ABDOMEN: Signs of surgical emergency - rigid abdomen, GI bleeding
SEVERE_ABD_PAIN: Severe sudden abdominal pain - possible surgical condition
POSSIBLE_APPENDICITIS: Right lower quadrant pain with fever - concerning for appendicitis
POSSIBLE_GALLBLADDER: Right upper quadrant pain - possible gallbladder disease
THUNDERCLAP_HEADACHE: Sudden severe headache - possible intracranial hemorrhage
POSSIBLE_MENINGITIS: Headache with stiff neck and fever - possible meningitis
HEADACHE_NEURO_SYMPTOMS: Headache with neurological symptoms - requires urgent evaluation
VERTIGO_HEARING: Vertigo with hearing changes - possible inner ear condition
CAUDA_EQUINA_SIGNS: Back pain with neurological warning signs - possible cauda equina syndrome
BACK_INFECTION_CONCERN: Back pain with fever - possible spinal infection
MECHANICAL_BACK_PAIN: Mechanical back pain without red flags
DEHYDRATION_RISK: Unable to keep fluids down - dehydration risk
VIRAL_URI: Symptoms consistent with viral upper respiratory infection
UTI_WITH_FEVER: Urinary tract infection with systemic symptoms
MENINGOCOCCAL_CONCERN: Petechial rash with fever - possible meningococcal disease
SEPTIC_JOINT: Hot swollen joint with fever - possible joint infection
SUICIDE_RISK: Suicidal or self-harm ideation - crisis intervention needed
SYNCOPE_ARRHYTHMIA: Palpitations with syncope - possible dangerous arrhythmia
PALPITATIONS_KNOWN_CARDIAC: Palpitations in patient with known heart disease
SPINAL_CORD_COMPRESSION: Symptoms concerning for spinal cord compression
FACIAL_NERVE_INVOLVEMENT: Ear infection with facial nerve involvement
DVT_HIGH_RISK: High clinical suspicion for deep vein thrombosis
NEUTROPENIC_FEVER: Fever with severely low white blood cells
KIDNEY_DYSFUNCTION: Elevated kidney function tests with symptoms
